Jonas Brothers in Phoenix, November 27, 2026: Desert Diamond Arena parking, doors and the ride

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: the Jonas Brothers play Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale on Friday, November 27, 2026, with doors at 6:30 p.m. and the show at 7:30 p.m. The arena lots open an hour before doors and take cards only, and bags can be up to 12 by 12 by 6 inches. For a group, one chauffeured vehicle replaces the lot, the card reader and the drive home.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

When are the Jonas Brothers in Phoenix?

The Jonas Brothers play Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale on Friday, November 27, 2026, the day after Thanksgiving, on The Burning Up Tour All Over Again. Doors open at 6:30 p.m. and the show starts at 7:30 p.m., as the arena’s event page lists them. It is one night in the Phoenix area. The arena is at 9400 West Maryland Avenue, Glendale, AZ 85305, in the Westgate Entertainment District off Loop 101, not in downtown Phoenix: plan the ride to the West Valley. By Google’s typical drive time, measured without event traffic, the arena is 23 minutes from downtown Phoenix, 28 from Phoenix Sky Harbor and 36 from Old Town Scottsdale or Kierland. On a sold-out holiday Friday, the last mile takes the longest.

Where do you park for the Jonas Brothers at Desert Diamond Arena?

In the arena’s own lots, which open one hour before doors, so at 5:30 p.m. for this show. Day-of spaces are in lots G, J, L, Yellow, the Garage and VIP as the event allows, the entrances take cards only, and a space pre-paid on the event page is held until 30 minutes after the start. The arena publishes no parking price: it is set by event and shown when you buy the space. Every pass covers one standard space, oversized vehicles buy more, and overnight parking is not allowed. Our Desert Diamond Arena guide has the full lot rules and the parking map. Or skip the lot: a chauffeured group is dropped where arena staff direct and picked up at a point agreed before the show, so nobody queues at a card reader or drives home.

Where does a limo or party bus drop off for the Jonas Brothers?

Desert Diamond Arena publishes no rideshare, limo, charter or bus drop-off zone, so a chauffeured group unloads where arena staff and police direct on the night and agrees one pickup point for the ride home before walking in. The chauffeur drives the approach the event traffic allows and meets the group once the crowd clears. If the arena publishes a drop-off plan for the show, that plan replaces this paragraph.

What bags are allowed at the Jonas Brothers concert?

Desert Diamond Arena allows bags and purses up to 12 by 12 by 6 inches, clear or not. Laptop bags, briefcases, camera bags, coolers, luggage and seat cushions are not allowed at any size, and neither is outside food or drink apart from a factory-sealed water bottle under 17 ounces. Settle bags at the hotel or at home. A group that is dropped off has no car in the lot to go back to.

How should a group plan the Jonas Brothers night?

Work back from the 6:30 p.m. doors: a pickup that lands the group at the arena around doors leaves time for the lines and the bag check, and one that leaves earlier makes room for dinner at Westgate, across Entertainment Boulevard from the arena. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for the whole evening: pickup, dinner, the show and the ride home, with the chauffeur waiting nearby. Or book a ride there and a ride back. Tell us the dinner reservation when you book, and the chauffeur sets the pickup around it.

Is there a VIP or early-entry option for the Jonas Brothers at Desert Diamond Arena?

Yes, two upgrades sold on the arena’s Jonas Brothers event page. The Bassline Bar lets guests in 60 minutes before general doors, between Gates 3 and 4, with a private bar and bathroom all night and the arena’s only outdoor smoking section. VIP parking is reserved front-row parking with an express lane in and out. The Bassline Bar is not a show ticket: every guest still needs a Jonas Brothers ticket as well. For this show it means going in at 5:30 p.m., an hour before the 6:30 p.m. doors, so a group booked into it sets the pickup an hour earlier than the plan below. A chauffeured group needs neither parking pass: it is dropped where arena staff direct and picked up at the point agreed before the show. The arena also rents its premium spaces for single events.

Which vehicle fits a group going to the Jonas Brothers?

Our pick for the Jonas Brothers is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, seating 15. A VIP night takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter (9 seats), the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban); a friend crew takes the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) or the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax); a big group takes the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28 seats). The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter has fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes, lasers and a fog machine, an ultra-premium sound system and a partition with an intercom to your chauffeur. The Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum; the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax, so one more rider does not change it. Families with younger fans ride the Executive Black Sprinter, reclining leather with room for everyone’s coats, or the Mini Bus (24 Pax) for a bigger family group. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com with the show, the pickup address and the rider count. Count riders for the ride home as well as the ride there.
